verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser ships an official first-party MCP server (npm package hyperbrowser-mcp) documented at docs/integrations/model-context-protocol, exposing tools like scrape_webpage, extraction, and crawling; a runtime probe confirms it installs and responds to JSON-RPC initialize with proper serverInfo. missing for 10: independent third-party review of the MCP server's tool reliability/coverage beyond the vendor docs and single probe.
